name: bizplug-landscaping
description: The landscaping & lawn plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: estimate lawn and landscape work. It works from the business's own published profile, covering services, seasonal plans and quote requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
